label: PF Backlog 554
title: CI4: regenerate committed derived artifacts (api/openapi.json + docs README/BACKLOG-SUMMARY/documentation-index)
body:
## Problem
`api-governance` FAILs (OpenAPI drift: 4 backlog epic/status routes) and `docs-fresh` FAILs (stale docs/README.md, BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md, documentation-index.html). Generated artifacts are out of sync with sources.
## Fix
Regenerate + commit: `scripts/dev/api_governance_check.py --write`, `scripts/dev/gen_docs_index.py`, `scripts/dev/gen_backlog_summary.py`.
## Acceptance
api-governance + docs-fresh pass.
